jobs.title: Campus Police Sergeant: Lead Safety & Campus Protection
jobs.description:
Texas Southern University is seeking a Police Officer with certification pay to enforce campus policies and manage security operations. The role includes supervising shifts, coordinating incident responses, and maintaining safety for students, faculty, and staff.

Essential duties include reporting, investigations, and proactive patrol planning. Bachelor’s degree is preferred and TCOLE certification is required, with opportunities for advancement and tuition reimbursement.

jobs.title: Campus Safety Patrol Officer – Protect Students
jobs.description:
Young World Physical Education in Houston, Texas, is seeking a Patrol Police Officer. This full-time role involves protecting students and staff, enforcing laws, and maintaining safety within Alief ISD.

The ideal candidate must hold a high school diploma or GED and a Texas Peace Officer License. Responsibilities include patrolling the district, responding to emergencies, and collaborating with other police agencies.

The position offers a competitive salary ranging from $63,857 to $88,115 based on experience and is expected to work 260 days a year.
